theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ), 0 < w → HasFPowerSeriesAt P p 0 → (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < s → P (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / (w : ℂ)) * t) = P t) → ∀ n : ℕ, ¬ w ∣ n → p.coeff n = 0
